blocks.en: A product (AND) of all variables that output a 1. Complemented if value is 0 (A'), uncomplemented if 1 (A).

blocks.en: A sum (OR) of all variables that output a 0. Complemented if value is 1 (A'), uncomplemented if 0 (A).
